i write this not only as a mother that has birthed three babies at mission bernal but also as a doula that has supported countless clients both at mission bernal and other bay area hospitals. the care provided by the mb team is simply unparalleled. every prenatal appoint i was treated like i was the only patient they had to see that day. i was warmly welcomed and my questions were always answered thoroughly, never rushed. i had an uncomplicated beautiful birth my first time around so going there for my second pregnancy with twins was a no-brainer.  during the delivery of my twins, after delivering my fist twin vaginally, there were complications with the second twin and it looked like it might go to a c-section. pemberton and norell were simply amazing. they managed to deliver the second twin vaginally as well. i think the most important take away from my experience is that i felt like an active-participant in both my births.  i felt safe, heard, supported, and empowered. i felt like the midwives genuinely cared about my physical and emotional well being- probably because they did! even at the end, when i felt like i couldn't go any longer, they made me believe that i could- and i did! they trust the birth process and a woman's ability to birth, and they help their patients believe it, too! surly this factors into their low intervention rates! i love the mb team and sing their praises at every opportunity. 
now, putting on my doula hat... i have seen so many beautiful births at mission bernal that would've been a c-section anywhere else. again- they trust the process. in the last 2 years i've had over a half dozen clients leave cpmc van ness to get care at mb. all i say is, "go meet the midwives, check it out" and the rest is history.  cpmc van ness is very high intervention and not big on informed consent. in the birth community they have a reputation for bullying patients into unnecessary interventions and early inductions. mb midwives on the contrary, give our clients a voice. they empower our clients and make them feel safe. i think the reason so many clients switch from cpmc vn to mb is not just bc of the appealing intervention statistics but bc mb staff makes you feel like family- warm, loving and invested.

buyers beware! this hospital is known for unethical billing practices. you will be charged for services far higher than market average. 

we recently had an ultrasound completed on my pregnant wife at an outpatient doctor's office located near saint mary's hospital.  we received a bill from the doctor's office for the services.  we then received a second bill from st. mary's hospital charging us again for an ultrasound.  why would we receive a hospital bill when we were never in the hospital, we were in a doctors office? this bill was for over $5000 and was billed as if my wife was in the hospital as a patient. we went to an outpatient office. we have been to other physicians in this same building (which is not the hospital) and were never charged as if we were using inpatient services. after further research i found that this is over ten times the cost of this service looking at national and local averages.  we also were not admitted in saint mary's hospital.  

after calling to review these charges with bon secours customer service they informed us that we would have to take this issue up with the billing department of the doctor's office.  once we spoke with the doctor's office they said that it was a bill from saint mary's hospital and would have to be handled by them.  after calling bon secours back, they gave me the name of a contact that all billing complaints go through.  they refused to give me her email or phone number.  they said all issues must be through hand written letters.  we contacted her stating our issues and after some time received a letter back.  the contact only offered services which are openly provided through customer service (pay balance right now 15% discount or set up monthly payment plan).  wrote contact back trying to get explanation of charges and cited local health care cost averages for ultrasounds.  stated that these charges were billed unethically (as if we were admitted in the hospital) and that costs of services were not within market value and were not discussed with us ahead of time.  we waited a couple months and heard nothing back.  we called their customer service and they told us our letter was received and under review.  we waited a couple more months and a collection notice came in the mail from bon secours.  we called their customer service back and let them know about this issue and that it had been under review.  they stated the bill was unpaid and therefore sent to collections.  we were never able to speak with anyone with autonomy, were billed extremely unethically and nobody from their organization would directly communicate with us about their bill.  my wife and i have high credit scores and always pay our bills in accordance with our responsibilities.  this company refused to openly communicate with us or explain their absurd billing practices.  buyers beware!!! there are many other companies providing the same services in our area with far better customer service and for far cheaper.
